title: Mistral
assist_caption: I've got it. Watch how it's done, then it's yours.

call.caption: You, new hand! Clip on to the jackline before you do anything else.
call.retry: Tether. Jackline. Now. Nobody goes over the side on my boat.
call.ok: Good. Now you can't lose yourself. Watch the jib.

call.caption: Gust! Ease the jib! Ease, ease!
call.retry: She's rounding up! Let the jib sheet out, a good arm's length!
call.ok: That's it. Feel her come back on her feet.

call.caption: Ready about! Helm's going down. Bring her bow through the wind!
call.retry: Push the tiller away and keep it there. Through the wind, all the way!

call.caption: Grind! Bring the new jib sheet in, all the way!
call.retry: Keep grinding! That jib's flogging itself to pieces!
call.ok: Made. Nice work on the handles.

call.caption: Take the helm. Bear away and let her run down the face of this one.
call.retry: Bear away more. Wind over your shoulder, stern to the sea. Hold her there.
call.ok: Feel that? That's a thirty-metre boat surfing. Don't let it go to your head.

call.caption: Squall! Dump the main! Let it go, all of it!
call.retry: Main sheet off! Off! She'll broach!
call.ok: Good. Power off, boat under control. That's seamanship.

call.caption: There's the break. Harbour on the bow. Bring her up onto a reach and let's take her home.
call.retry: Head up a little more. Wind on the beam, the harbour wall to leeward.
call.ok: Well sailed. Every sailor starts somewhere. Yours starts on a lake.
